verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's CHKit is described as typed commands to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code, explicitly as "infrastructure an agent can drive, in CI, with a diff you can review." The service also speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so any ClickHouse client or driver can run scripted queries headlessly. missing for 10: in-depth CHKit docs (install, CI configuration, non-interactive auth/service credentials), a documented management API for headless cluster provisioning, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
